definition: a person who grinds grain into flour
description: Inside an old windmill lit by oil lanterns, a young woman covered in white flour dust, in work clothes and boots, hangs from a thick rope above a wooden case holding two large round millstones and slides down it to the stone floor. A huge wooden cogwheel sits under the roof beams. A young man climbs a ladder and a woman at a shutter looks on, flour pours from a wooden chute into a sack, and full sacks stand on the floor.

taps.phrase: to slide down a thick rope
to pour flour into a sack
